func load_topic_records() -> bool:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists("user://records.json"):
		topic_records = {}
		return false

	var file: FileAccess = FileAccess.open("user://records.json", FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		topic_records = {}
		return false

	var content: String = file.get_as_text()
	var json: JSON = JSON.new()
	var parse_result: Error = json.parse(content)

	if parse_result != OK:
		topic_records = {}
		return false

		topic_records = json.data
		return true

	topic_records = {}
	return false

	if topic_records.has(topic_name):

	return 0


func get_sorted_records(source: Dictionary = {}) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var target: Dictionary = source if not source.is_empty() else topic_records
	var records_list: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for topic in target:
		records_list.append({
			"topic": str(topic),
			"score": int(target[topic])
		})
	records_list.sort_custom(func(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary) -> bool:
		return a["score"] > b["score"]
	)
	return records_list

	var filtered: Array = source.filter(func(q: Question) -> bool:
		return q != null and q.options.size() > 2
	)
	var result: Array[Question] = []
	result.assign(filtered)
	return result


func filter_wrong_questions(source: Array[Question], wrong_pool: Array[Question]) -> Array[Question]:
	var filtered: Array = source.filter(func(q: Question) -> bool:
		return q != null and wrong_pool.has(q)
	)
	var result: Array[Question] = []
	result.assign(filtered)
	return result

	var json_string: String = JSON.stringify(settings_data)
	var file: FileAccess = FileAccess.open("user://settings.json", FileAccess.WRITE)

func load_audio_settings() -> void:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists("user://settings.json"):
		return

	var file: FileAccess = FileAccess.open("user://settings.json", FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		return

	var content: String = file.get_as_text()
	var json: JSON = JSON.new()
	if json.parse(content) != OK:
		return

	if not (json.data is Dictionary):
		return

	var data: Dictionary = json.data

	if data.has("master_volume"):
		var val: float = maxf(0.0001, float(data["master_volume"]))
		master_slider.value = val
		if _master_bus_idx >= 0:
			AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(_master_bus_idx, linear_to_db(val))

	if data.has("music_volume"):
		var val: float = maxf(0.0001, float(data["music_volume"]))
		music_slider.value = val
		if _music_bus_idx >= 0:
			AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(_music_bus_idx, linear_to_db(val))

	if data.has("sfx_volume"):
		var val: float = maxf(0.0001, float(data["sfx_volume"]))
		sfx_slider.value = val
		if _sfx_bus_idx >= 0:
			AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(_sfx_bus_idx, linear_to_db(val))

	if data.has("is_muted"):
		var muted: bool = bool(data["is_muted"])
		mute_button.button_pressed = muted
		if _master_bus_idx >= 0:
			AudioServer.set_bus_mute(_master_bus_idx, muted)
